## Presentation files

This site is hosted as a static GitHub Pages website and cannot receive file
uploads directly. A secure external upload service and submission instructions
must be selected before participants can submit presentation files. Please do
not email or upload presentation files until the project team publishes
instructions.

Presentation slides, recordings, or other materials will only be shared when
the relevant participants have given permission.
